Quick update from platform:
- Ingest logs show the upload accepted a blob but our PDF sanitizer flagged XMP metadata and an embedded signature object that triggers the "unsupported file contents" rule in the 3.2 schema. It is deterministic for that blob (sha256: 1f8a...e2c).
- The sanitizer is intentionally strict because we've had cases of malformed PDFs interfering with OCR-based tax checks.

Workarounds:
1) Vendor re-export: Ask the vendor to "Print to PDF" from Acrobat/Preview (this tends to flatten layers) and re-upload. That usually fixes invisible signatures.
2) Manual intake: We can accept the PDF via a manual procurement intake ticket (HS-54821) and have the file scanned and cleared by the onboarding team — ETA 24–36 hrs.

Recommended: try (1) first to meet their go-live date; if that fails, I can spin up an intake with priority. Also adding a small temporary exception for the vendor is possible but needs approval from Procurement (Laura).

-karthik

Sam — thanks for your patience. Two options to unblock you quickly:

Option A (fast, vendor action):
- Open the W-9 on your machine and choose File → Print → select "Save as PDF" (or "Microsoft Print to PDF" on Windows). This flattens any signature layers. Then re-upload to the portal.

Option B (we help):
- Reply to this email with permission to intake the attached PDF via our procurement ops. We'll open HS-54821 and run a manual check; expect 24–36 hours. We will not store the document longer than needed per your retention instructions.

If you can re-export and upload now, that will likely resolve it immediately. If you prefer we handle it, say the word and I'll request priority intake from Laura.
